messages:
maya: Heads up — main went red right after merging PR #8142. smoke-e2e/gpu-1 failed on kv_cache_smoke. CI job: https://ci.redwood/jobs/12345
ci-bot: Build #12345 — smoke-e2e/gpu-1 — FAILED. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/12345
sam: can you paste the failing stack or code snippet?
maya: sure, excerpt:
```text
[ RUN      ] KVCacheSmokeTest.AllocateOnDemand
../tests/kv_cache_test.cpp:142: Assertion `alloc_size == expected' failed.
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
```
jen: I own kv cache tests — will take a look, give me 15m.
leo: I'm oncall; can someone try a quick rerun? might be flake after the merge.
sam: /ci rerun 12345
ci-bot: Rerun queued for build #12345 => new build #12346
ci-bot: Build #12346 — smoke-e2e/gpu-1 — FAILED (same assert)
jen: still failing on #12346. suspect memory allocation change from merged commit abcdef1
maya: PR #8142 merged commit abcdef123456 — touches allocator path
jen: ok, I'll start a bisect between main~5 and main. If I can't find a culprit in 30m we should consider reverting the PR.
leo: +1. tagging @eng-sre for visibility
sam: jotting down bisect steps: `git bisect start --bad main --good main~5 && git bisect run ./tests/run_smoke_gpu.sh`
jen: starting bisect now. I'll post updates here.
jen: first bisect job failed on commit fedcba9 — looks like failure introduced earlier than PR. digging.
maya: thanks — if it's pre-PR we can keep PR as-is but need a revert if root cause is earlier.
leo: if you need additional GPU machines, DM me.
jen: update: found commit 1a2b3c4 that flips the allocator flag — reproduces locally. opening issue and draft revert/patch.
maya: thanks all. tagging for follow-up: please add blamelist in the issue and we'll schedule hotfix if needed. :eyes:
